description: Reutiliza os hooks do harness em .claude no Codex.

hooks.command: node "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.codex/hooks/commit-guard.mjs" | node -e 'let output = ""; process.stdin.on("data", (chunk) => output += chunk).on("end", () => { if (!output.trim()) return; const result = JSON.parse(output); delete result.continue; process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(result)); })'
